story_type: long-range hoist from a fishing boat underway, trail line basket
hook: 225 miles from San Diego, his hand was badly hurt.
narration: Two hundred and twenty-five miles south of San Diego, a man on this fishing boat had badly hurt his hand.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew flew out and found the Intrepid at about seven thirty in the morning.
For a hoist like this, the boat holds a steady course and the helicopter flies above it at the same speed.
The flight mechanic lowered the rescue basket about sixty feet, with a trail line so the crew below could guide it onto the deck.
He could still walk, so he climbed into the basket on his own.
Then the cable came tight, and the basket lifted off the moving deck.
outcome: The aircrew hoisted him aboard and flew him back to San Diego, where an ambulance was waiting.
title: Hoisted off a moving boat 225 miles out
description:
On Sept. 26, 2011, a Coast Guard Jayhawk crew hoisted a fisherman with a badly injured hand off the fishing boat Intrepid, 225 miles south of San Diego, and flew him back to waiting paramedics.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Allyson E.T. Conroy, Coast Guard District 11, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/317240/110926-long-range-medevac

facts.claim: Man medevaced 225 miles south of San Diego on Sept. 26, 2011 after severely injuring his hand on the fishing boat Intrepid
facts.source_quote: The U.S. Coast Guard medically evacuated a 30-year-old man 225 miles south of San Diego Sep. 26, 2011. The man severely injured his hand while underway on the commercial fishing boat Intrepid

facts.claim: Crew arrived about 7:30 and did a basket hoist with a trail line at about 60 feet
facts.source_quote: We got there at about 730 and we conducted a basket hoist with the trail line to the vessel at about 60 feet.

facts.claim: He was able to walk and got into the basket himself
facts.source_quote: He was ambulatory so he just got in the basket, came up and in flight monitored him.

facts.claim: Flown 220 miles back to Sector San Diego and handed to an ambulance
facts.source_quote: We flew from the location of the vessel which was 220 miles down in Mexican waters. All the way up here to Sector San Diego where he was offloaded from the helicopter and loaded onto San Diego. Emergency medical services, paramedic ambulance.
